name: HP benchmark
description: This dataset was developed by the HKUST-GZ iGEM 2026 team at The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology (Guangzhou) to support case retrieval, project comparison, and evidence-linked Human Practices workflows in GEMR Studio. The archive contains structured records for 413 selected iGEM 2025 teams, including project background, available Wet Lab and Dry Lab context, and 1,514 recorded Human Practices entries. Records retain source references and distinguish available information from missing or unresolved fields. These entries describe team-reported work and should not be interpreted as independently verified activities or experimental outcomes. The accompanying shared reference graph connects team-case content with methodological guidance and Wiki-writing references. The package includes graph indexes and their source dependencies, data dictionaries, provenance documentation, file manifests, and offline integrity-checking tools. This v3 derivative removes the reviewer.name field from the case records and corresponding graph source copies. The change is documented, and file identities and source references have been updated accordingly. This targeted removal does not imply that all free text has been anonymized. Data collection, processing, curation, and review involved multiple team members and volunteers, whose collective contributions are acknowledged in the archive. Team-authored summaries, annotations, and new documentation are made available under CC BY 4.0.
